notes: Fixes from a code audit of the last three releases, before any of it could bite in an op. The big one: v0.12.3 taught FleetComm to ride out network blips on the account check instead of signing you out — but a fault ON the server (as opposed to on the way to it) still counted as 'your access changed' and would have signed out every connected operator at once; server faults now count as blips too, and you stay on comms. Also: the new 'FLEETCOMM UPDATED — UNDERSTOOD' screen could be wiped by an automatic update starting seconds later, before you read it — the update now politely waits for your acknowledgement. And an overnight relay outage could quietly exhaust an internal limit so that nets tuned afterwards transmitted nothing when keyed; reconnect attempts no longer consume anything. Plus: during a long accounts outage the log reminds you every ~5 minutes instead of one easy-to-miss line, and being revoked no longer mislabels itself as 'session expired'.
